config.comment: Same intake/methodology as gemma4-e2b-qat.json, with E4B base google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-mobile-transformers. Apache License 2.0; ONNX export artifact revision/hashes pinned, exporter/base SHA not documented. Mixed QAT precision (q2f16 suffix). Text-only embeddings and decoder, including two decoder external-data shards, total 3,361,444,484 bytes: under 3.5 GB ceiling. No vision/audio claims or shipping acceptance. Same no-thinking prompt, tool semantics, budgets and sampling as E2B/LFM3 control. Vendor recommended sampling differs from this controlled Pouch experiment.

measurementNotes.rss: Sampled Chrome process-tree RSS; shared pages may be double counted. Peaks are sampled lower bounds, not allocator maxima.
measurementNotes.gpu: System-wide Apple IOAccelerator counter, noisy and not model VRAM. Do not add it to RSS.
measurementNotes.prefill: input tokens / TTFT, an end-to-end proxy including generation setup, not an isolated kernel timer.
measurementNotes.load: Loopback files with warm OS page cache, not network download latency.
